title: Prehistoric Park Triceratops texture (F/A)
description: Retextures the Triceratops from Fossils & Archeology: Revival Genesis to look like Prehistoric Park's triceratops.
body:
This resource pack for Fossils & Archeology: Revival Genesis (https://modrinth.com/mod/fossils-and-archeology-revival) adds the textures I (Gobspout) made for my video recreating Prehistoric Park in Minecraft. 

See more here: https://www.youtube.com/@Gobspout|

Disclosure: I am not the owner of the Fossils & Archeology mod nor have a hand in its development. I am simply a fan who made a custom texture.
